commits.headline: perf(build): a Wine prefix per program building at once
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: One wineserver serves a whole prefix and runs single-threaded, so tools/build.py all queued every program's assembler and linker behind it: on a 64-thread box the wineserver sat at 99% of one core with the machine half idle. all and levels now hand each program running at once a prefix of its own, build/wine/<slot>, made once with wineboot and reused. A WINEPREFIX already set, or RAC2_ONE_PREFIX=1, keeps the old single prefix.

commits.headline: test(build): the parallel build's prefixes, and the strict test on one prefix
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: test_parallel_build_propagates_strict_and_child_failure counts subprocess.run calls, which now include the prefixes' wineboot: it keeps one prefix (RAC2_ONE_PREFIX=1). New tests check that each program building at once gets a prefix of its own under build/wine and that WINEPREFIX, RAC2_ONE_PREFIX or one job keep one.
